raw_text: {"relevant_claims":["Because the promotion's margin relief is tied to its validity window, pricing should be reviewed after 2026-12-31.","Q4GROWTH is valid on the decision date and lowers the minimum margin by 5 percentage points, from 33% to 28% for micro merchants.","The merchant's request for the Q4GROWTH rate and its holiday-market enrollment context are unverified merchant statements."],"evidence_ids":["PRC-2026.2§1","PRC-2026.2§2","PRC-2026.2§3","PRC-2026.2§4","PRC-2026.2§5","PRC-2026.2§6","PRC-2026.2§7","PRC-2026.2§8","FACT-decision_date","FACT-profile","FACT-cost","FACT-request","FACT-exception","FACT-volume","FACT-transactions"],"explanation":"No material claim is unsupported. Each one traces to the evidence. PRC-2026.2§1 applies from 2026-09-01 until superseded, so it covers the 2026-12-01 decision date (FACT-decision_date). PRC-2026.2§6 lists Q4GROWTH as valid 2026-10-01 to 2026-12-31 with a 5-point reduction in minimum margin. Applied to the micro minimum of 33% in PRC-2026.2§3 (merchant size per FACT-profile), that gives 28%. FACT-cost confirms cost data is unavailable, so PRC-2026.2§8's default cost basis and pricing_desk routing apply. The discount threshold and regional_pricing_manager approval come from PRC-2026.2§4, using the micro list rate in PRC-2026.2§2. Promotions_lead approval comes from PRC-2026.2§6. The $3M deal_desk threshold comes from PRC-2026.2§5, and the strategic-exception logic from PRC-2026.2§7. The agent correctly labels the merchant's request and context as unverified (FACT-request, FACT-exception) rather than treating them as fact. The closing advice to review pricing after 2026-12-31 is a forward-looking suggestion. It follows from the stated validity window in PRC-2026.2§6, is not presented as a policy requirement, and does not affect the decision.
